//: Separate from tsconfig.json because the package's own program is a Next
app: it includes .tsx components, JSX, next/* imports and browser globals,
none of which node can load. This config compiles ONLY the modules that
are free of them, to plain CommonJS that `node --test` can require.
`files` is an explicit list rather than a glob on purpose, copying
apps/mobile/tsconfig.test.json. A module can be added here only by someone
who has checked it has no React, next/* or DOM import, and the compile
fails loudly rather than the test silently pulling a browser module in.
`moduleResolution: node` and `module: commonjs` override the app's
`bundler`/`esnext` pair, which only a bundler can resolve.
